verdict.rationale: React's own docs point developers to third-party full-stack frameworks (Next.js, React Router) rather than providing a first-party CLI or starter template of their own, so scaffolding is delegated rather than delivered directly by React. missing for 10: an official React-branded CLI/starter (e.g. create-react-app equivalent), first-party quick-start scaffold command, and any timing/'few minutes' claims or hands-on corroboration of setup speed.
